name: phonedriver
description: Lets an agent see and operate Android phones and iPhones: the screen as text, taps by element number, and a question to you before any tap that pays. Bundles the phonedriver MCP server and its skill.

interface.shortDescription: Let your agent use a phone
interface.longDescription: phonedriver lets an agent see and operate Android phones, Android emulators, the iOS Simulator and iPhones. The screen arrives as a short numbered text list, taps go by element number, and every action returns only the lines that changed. A tap that pays, orders, transfers or deletes an account is held until you approve it. The plugin starts the phonedriver MCP server on your computer with npx and adds the skill that teaches the agent how to use it. It sends no telemetry.
